senses.gloss: गौण a. (f. णी) 1. Subordinate, secondary, unessential, e.g. गौणे कर्मणि दुह्यादेः प्रधाने नीहृकृष्वहाम्; 2. used in a secondary sense, figurative, metaphorical (as a word or sense); 3. based on some similarity between the primary and secondary sense of a word, as in गौणी लक्षणा K.Pr.ii.; 4. relating to multiplication or enumeration.
